description:
Rank AI build tools and coding-agent harnesses for an app idea with deterministic, documented scoring (no LLM).
Use when: the user describes what they want to build and asks which AI tool to use.
Do not use for: the user already named the tools to choose between (compare_tools).
Returns: ranked results with score breakdown, pricing with checked date and source, and example apps with links.
Limits: Scores use shipped-app counts, idea match, platform, experience, budget vs stated pricing and preferred harness. limit 1-10, default 5.
Example: {"idea":"habit tracker mobile app","platform":"mobile","experience":"beginner","budget_usd_month":25}

budget_usd_month.description: Monthly tool budget in USD; 0 = free tiers only.

idea.description: The app idea in plain text.

preferred_harness.description: Slug or name the user prefers, e.g. claude-code.

name: recommend_stack
title: Recommend an AI build stack
